cards.limitations: 内容来自视频讲解，未提供可复现实验、基准测试或性能数据。关于微调能带来多大提升、具体硬件配置与量化取舍，均依赖作者经验性建议，需自行验证。文中涉及的模型、工具与链接可能随时间变化，且不构成投资建议。
cards.titleEn: Building Your Own AI Agent: From Agent Harness to Local Small-Model Fine-Tuning
cards.summaryEn: The video uses PewDiePie's Odysseus to explain the basics of an agent harness and tool calling. It also discusses running models locally with llama.cpp and Hugging Face, and fine-tuning Qwen 3.5 9B on agent traces so the model calls tools more reliably inside a custom harness. The specific training methods and configurations are the presenter's explanations and suggestions, not general conclusions verified by evidence in the video.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It turns agents from a concept into an actionable engineering path: understanding the agent loop and tool calling, choosing local versus cloud inference, and improving tool-calling reliability through trace fine-tuning. For developers interested in AI and quantitative work and in building their own agents, it serves as an introductory and selection reference.
cards.description: 该视频以PewDiePie自建AI助手Odysseus为例，拆解智能体运行框架、工具调用、本地推理与在智能体轨迹上微调小模型的流程，并给出Hugging Face、llama.cpp等相关资源。对想理解或动手搭建自有智能体的开发者有参考价值。
keyPointsEn: Uses Odysseus as an example to break down an agent harness, tool calling, and context (system prompt, tools, memory).
Compares local models with cloud APIs regarding privacy, latency, and offline use, and covers finding open-source models on Hugging Face.
Introduces local inference with llama.cpp, matching models to hardware and quantization (Q4 vs. BF16), and fine-tuning Qwen 3.5 9B on agent traces.
cards.title: 自建AI智能体：从智能体框架到本地小模型微调
cards.summary: 视频以PewDiePie的Odysseus为例，介绍智能体运行框架与工具调用的基本原理。视频还讨论了如何用llama.cpp与Hugging Face在本地运行模型，以及在智能体轨迹上微调Qwen 3.5 9B，使模型在自有框架中更可靠地调用工具。作者提出的具体训练方法与配置属于其讲解与建议，并非已由视频内证据验证的通用结论。
cards.whyItMatters: 它把智能体从概念落到可操作的工程路径：理解智能体循环与工具调用、选择本地或云端推理、以及通过轨迹微调提升工具调用可靠性。对关注AI与量化及自建智能体的开发者，可作为入门与选型参考。
cards.descriptionEn: Using PewDiePie's Odysseus as a case study, the video breaks down how an agent harness runs, how tool calling works, how to run models locally with llama.cpp and Hugging Face, and how to fine-tune a small model like Qwen 3.5 9B on agent traces. It is a practical reference for developers who want to understand or build their own agents.
cards.originalTitle: How to Build Your Own AI Agent (Like PewDiePie)
keyPoints: 以Odysseus为例拆解智能体框架、工具调用与上下文（系统提示、工具、记忆）的构成。
对比本地模型与云端API，讨论隐私、延迟、离线可用性，并介绍在Hugging Face上寻找开源模型。
介绍用llama.cpp做本地推理、按硬件与量化（Q4与BF16）选择模型，以及在智能体轨迹上微调Qwen 3.5 9B。
cards.limitationsEn: The content comes from a video presentation and provides no reproducible experiments, benchmarks, or performance data. Claims about how much fine-tuning helps, specific hardware configurations, and quantization trade-offs rely on the presenter's empirical advice and require independent verification. The models, tools, and links mentioned may change over time, and this is not investment advice.

cards.limitations: 研究仅基于arXiv摘要，未提供详细的实验设置、统计显著性、计算成本或失败案例分析。理论保证依赖于有限重复采样和每动作至少m次观察的条件，实际应用中可能受采样预算和专家响应质量影响。四类基准和四类模型是否覆盖所有LLM智能体场景仍需进一步验证。
cards.titleEn: SynAct: Decision-Level Active Feedback Learning for LLM Agents
cards.summaryEn: LLM agents can fail through recoverable slips or knowledge gaps, with only the latter requiring external feedback. SynAct treats expert attention as a binding constraint, ranks decisions by mutual information between action and terminal outcome, queries experts at high-value decisions, and distills corrections into reusable rules. Across four benchmarks and four models, it improves held-out accuracy in all 16 settings, by an average of 11.7 percentage points.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This approach offers a more efficient way to allocate scarce expert feedback for LLM agents, potentially improving reliability and deployment efficiency in multi-step tasks, and may enhance inference-time routing decisions.
cards.description: 该研究提出SynAct框架，将专家反馈从任务级细化到决策级，通过互信息识别对最终结果有影响的关键决策点，从而在专家注意力稀缺时更有效地提升LLM智能体的多步工作流准确率。
keyPointsEn: SynAct allocates expert feedback at the level of individual decisions rather than whole tasks, addressing scarce expert attention.
It uses repeated rollouts to compute mutual information between actions and outcomes, identifying decisions that separate terminal results, with theoretical separation conditions.
Evaluations across multiple benchmarks and models show an average improvement of 11.7 percentage points, and a single targeted correction outperforms seven unaimed retries.
The same signal improves inference-time routing, outperforming budget-matched cascade, uncertainty, and expert-judge routers in most settings.
cards.title: SynAct：以决策级主动反馈提升LLM智能体表现
cards.summary: LLM智能体在多步任务中失败可归为可恢复失误与知识缺口两类，前者重试可修复，后者需外部反馈。SynAct将专家反馈视为稀缺资源，在决策级别上根据所选动作与最终结果间的互信息排序，将反馈集中在最高价值的决策上，并将纠正蒸馏为可复用规则。作者报告在四个基准和四个模型共16个设置中均提升泛化准确率，平均+11.7个百分点。
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法为LLM智能体提供了一种更高效的专家反馈分配机制，在专家资源有限时能显著提升多步任务的可靠性和部署效率，并可能改善推理阶段的路由决策。
cards.descriptionEn: This work introduces SynAct, a framework that allocates expert feedback at the individual decision level rather than at the task level, using mutual information to identify consequential decisions and improve multi-step LLM agent accuracy under scarce expert attention.
cards.originalTitle: SynAct: Synergistic Active Feedback Learning for LLM Agents
keyPoints: SynAct将专家反馈分配到单个决策级别，而非整个任务级别，以应对专家注意力稀缺的约束。
通过重复采样计算动作与最终结果之间的互信息，识别出对结果有区分度的决策点，理论分析给出了分离条件。
在多基准多模型评估中，SynAct平均提升11.7个百分点，且单一针对性纠正优于多次无目标重试。
该信号还可用于推理时路由，在多数设置中优于预算匹配的级联、不确定性和专家判断路由策略。
cards.limitationsEn: The analysis is based solely on the arXiv abstract, lacking detailed experimental settings, statistical significance, computational costs, or failure case analysis. Theoretical guarantees rely on finite repeated sampling and at least m observations per action, which may be constrained by sampling budget and expert response quality in practice. Whether the four benchmarks and four models cover all LLM agent scenarios requires further validation.

cards.limitations: 论文摘要仅报告了在自建ReasoningShield基准和有限评测中的结果，未说明对真实生产环境、多轮交互或对抗性攻击的鲁棒性；91.8% F1、35.6%和15.8%等数字均为摘要中的单次报告，缺乏独立复现与统计显著性的细节；基准覆盖的10类风险、8个LRM和3个安全等级是否足以代表所有推理范式与风险场景，尚需进一步验证；轻量模型的泛化结论基于特定数据集，跨领域、跨语言及未知风险类型的有效性仍需独立评估。
cards.titleEn: ReasoningShield: Safety Detection over Reasoning Traces of Large Reasoning Models
cards.summaryEn: The study finds that the intermediate reasoning steps of large reasoning models can contain harmful content while the final answer appears benign, causing existing moderation tools to lose up to 35.2% F1 on CoT moderation. The authors build the ReasoningShield benchmark with 9.2K (Query, CoT) pairs spanning 10 risk categories, 3 safety levels, and 8 LRM paradigms, and develop lightweight 1B/3B models via a two-stage training strategy that achieve 91.8% F1, outperforming LlamaGuard-4 by 35.6% and GPT-4o by 15.8%. The authors argue that the benchmark and models generalize effectively across diverse reasoning paradigms and unseen scenarios, but independent verification of generalization is still needed.
cards.whyItMattersEn: As large reasoning models are increasingly deployed for complex tasks, their Chain-of-Thought traces are becoming a new attack surface: harmful content can bypass answer-level moderation. ReasoningShield advances safety detection to the reasoning-trace level and provides public benchmarks, models, and training resources, helping safety researchers and developers assess and mitigate CoT-specific risks — a direct reference for building trustworthy reasoning systems.
cards.description: 该研究系统揭示了大推理模型（LRMs）的思维链（CoT）会引入独特的隐蔽安全威胁：有害内容可嵌入中间步骤，而最终答案看似无害。现有主流审核工具在CoT场景下性能大幅下降（F1最多降低35.2%）。为此，作者发布ReasoningShield基准（含9.2K标注样本）并训练了1B/3B轻量模型，在CoT安全审核上达到91.8% F1，显著优于LlamaGuard-4和GPT-4o，且能跨推理范式与未知场景泛化。这为AI安全审核从答案层转向推理过程层提供了可复用的数据、模型和评测
keyPointsEn: Reveals the unique safety risk that harmful content can be embedded in CoT intermediate steps while the final answer appears benign; existing moderation tools lose up to 35.2% F1 in this setting.
Releases the ReasoningShield benchmark with 9.2K annotated (Query, CoT) pairs covering 10 risk categories, 3 safety levels, 8 LRMs, and diverse reasoning paradigms.

Develops lightweight 1B/3B models via two-stage training that achieve 91.8% F1 on the benchmark, outperforming LlamaGuard-4 by 35.6% and GPT-4o by 15.8%, and reports generalization across paradigms and unseen scenarios.
cards.title: 大推理模型思维链安全风险与轻量检测新基准
cards.summary: 研究发现，大推理模型的思维链中间步骤可能包含有害内容，而最终答案却显得无害，导致现有审核工具在CoT审核上F1最多下降35.2%。作者构建了包含9.2K条（Query, CoT）对、覆盖10类风险、3个安全等级和8个LRM范式的ReasoningShield基准，并基于两阶段训练开发了1B/3B轻量模型，取得91.8% F1，比LlamaGuard-4高35.6%、比GPT-4o高15.8%。作者认为该基准和模型能有效泛化到多种推理范式和未知场景，但泛化能力仍需独立验证。
cards.whyItMatters: 随着大推理模型在复杂任务中的广泛应用，其思维链正成为新的攻击面：有害内容可绕过基于最终答案的审核。ReasoningShield将安全检测推进到推理轨迹层，并提供公开的基准、模型和训练资源，有助于安全研究者和开发者评估并缓解CoT特有的风险，对构建可信推理系统具有直接参考价值。
cards.descriptionEn: This study systematically reveals a unique hidden safety threat in large reasoning models (LRMs): harmful content can be embedded in intermediate Chain-of-Thought (CoT) steps while the final answer appears benign. Existing state-of-the-art moderation tools suffer substantial performance degradation on CoT moderation (F1 drops by up to 35.2%). To address this, the authors release the ReasoningShield benchmark (9.2K annotated pairs) and train lightweight 1B/3B models that achie
cards.originalTitle: ReasoningShield: Safety Detection over Reasoning Traces of Large Reasoning Models
keyPoints: 揭示CoT中间步骤可嵌入有害内容而最终答案无害的独特安全风险，现有审核工具在此场景下F1最多下降35.2%。
发布ReasoningShield基准，含9.2K标注（Query, CoT）对，覆盖10个风险类别、3个安全等级、8个LRM和不同推理范式。
基于两阶段训练开发的1B/3B轻量模型，在基准上达91.8% F1，比LlamaGuard-4高35.6%，比GPT-4o高15.8%，并报告了跨范式与未知场景的泛化效果。
cards.limitationsEn: The paper abstract reports results only on the self-built ReasoningShield benchmark and a limited evaluation; it does not address robustness in real production environments, multi-turn interactions, or adversarial attacks. The reported 91.8% F1, 35.6%, and 15.8% figures are single-run results from the abstract without details on independent replication or statistical significance. Whether the benchmark's 10 risk categories, 8 LRMs, and 3 safety levels sufficiently represent all reasoning paradigms and risk scenarios requires further validation. The generalization claims of the lightweight models are based on a specific dataset; effectiveness across domains, languages, and unseen risk types still needs independent assessment.

cards.limitations: 研究仅针对一个多智能体深度研究代理和GEPA方法，结论外推需谨慎。留出增益虽跨种子复现，但依赖自动引用奖励与噪声评判；出家族评判和手工复现虽支持迁移，但未覆盖所有任务类型或代理架构。验证-留出差距的解释基于消融，仍受小样本与评判噪声影响。文中不构成投资或部署建议。
cards.titleEn: Reflective Prompt Optimization: Topic-Disjoint Multi-Seed Evaluation of Transferable Gains
cards.summaryEn: Under a topic-disjoint split, reflective prompt optimization raises held-out citation reward from 0.702 to 0.781, and the gain replicates across three seeds. The authors find that nearly half of the winning prompt is a memorized answer key, yet ablation shows this content earns no reward even on the encoded training questions; the validation-minus-held-out gap is mainly small-sample selection under a noisy judge. The authors argue decomposed per-dimension feedback is the causal ingredient for transfer, and collapsing it to a single scalar reward makes held-out transfer negative.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Prompt optimization is cheap and produces human-readable artifacts, but on factual tasks it has a failure mode where training answers are written into the prompt, inflating in-distribution performance. This work shows credible evaluation of prompt optimizers requires held-out topics, multiple seeds, and verifier ablations, otherwise memorization or noisy selection may be mistaken for transferable behavior.
cards.description: 该研究将反思式提示进化（GEPA）用于多智能体深度研究代理的两个系统提示，在主题不重叠的划分下评估提示优化的可迁移性。新意在于揭示验证集与留出集差距是小样本选择而非记忆，并识别分解式反馈是增益迁移的因果要素，提醒评估需留出主题、多种子和验证器消融。
keyPointsEn: Under topic-disjoint split, held-out citation reward improves by 0.079 (bootstrap 95% CI [0.051, 0.107]), with mean 0.107 across three seeds.

Nearly half of the winning prompt is a memorized answer key, but ablation shows it earns no reward even on encoded training questions, so the validation-minus-held-out gap is small-sample selection rather than memorization.
Decomposed per-dimension feedback is the causal ingredient for transferable gain; collapsing it to a single scalar reward makes held-out transfer negative.
cards.title: 反思式提示优化：去主题重叠与多种子评估转移增益
cards.summary: 研究显示，在主题不重叠划分下，反思式提示优化可将留出引用奖励从0.702提升至0.781，增益跨三个种子复现。作者发现典型提示中近半内容为记忆答案键，但消融实验表明这些内容在训练问题上也不获奖励，验证-留出差距主要源于噪声评判下的小样本选择。作者观点认为，分解式逐维反馈是迁移增益的因果要素，将其简化为单一标量奖励会导致留出迁移为负。
cards.whyItMatters: 提示优化廉价且产生人类可读产物，但事实性任务上存在将训练答案写入提示而虚增分布内表现的失败模式。该工作表明，可信评估提示优化器需要留出主题、多种子以及验证器消融，否则可能将记忆或噪声选择误认为可迁移行为。
cards.descriptionEn: This study applies reflective prompt evolution (GEPA) to two system prompts of a multi-agent deep-research agent, evaluating transferability under a topic-disjoint split. Its novelty lies in showing that the validation-minus-held-out gap is small-sample selection rather than memorization, and identifying decomposed per-dimension feedback as the causal ingredient for transferable gains, implying credible evaluation requires held-out topics, multiple seeds, and verifier ablatio
cards.originalTitle: Reflective Prompt Optimization of a Deep-Research Agent: A Topic-Disjoint, Multi-Seed Protocol for Measuring Transferable Gains and Prompt-Level Overfitting
keyPoints: 主题不重叠划分下，留出引用奖励提升0.079（bootstrap 95%置信区间[0.051, 0.107]），三个种子均值0.107。
获胜提示近半为记忆答案键，但消融显示其在编码的训练问题上也不获奖励，验证-留出差距来自小样本选择而非记忆。
分解式逐维反馈是迁移增益的因果要素；塌缩为单一标量奖励会使留出迁移为负。
cards.limitationsEn: The study covers only one multi-agent deep-research agent and the GEPA method, so extrapolation requires caution. Although the held-out gain replicates across seeds, it relies on an automatic citation reward and a noisy judge; out-of-family judging and hand-written reproduction support transfer but do not cover all task types or agent architectures. The interpretation of the validation-minus-held-out gap is based on ablations and remains subject to small-sample and judge-noise effects. This does not constitute investment or deployment advice.

cards.limitations: 该研究为基准评测，不提出新的注意力算法；结论基于特定模型配置、现实表格形状和三种 GPU，未覆盖所有表格模型或硬件；未评估端到端训练/推理精度或下游任务效果，因此后端选择建议需结合具体场景验证。
cards.titleEn: Benchmarking Attention for Tabular Foundation Models Across Hardware and Shapes
cards.summaryEn: The paper notes that tabular in-context learners rely on alternating row and column attention, where row attention involves long sequences and column attention short ones, with strided memory layouts and small hidden dimensions, while efficient attention research has focused on one-dimensional sequences. The authors benchmark multiple attention backends on A100, H100, and B200 GPUs and find that the optimal backend differs between column and row attention and varies with hardware and model specifics; FlashAttention implementations tailored to each GPU generation perform overall best, but are sometimes outperformed by cuDNN for column attention at longer sequences with cross-over points depending on head dimension. The authors state that this reproducible benchmark lays the foundation for future improvements to table-native attention (author viewpoint).
cards.whyItMattersEn: Tabular foundation models are increasingly important in real-world tasks, but their attention patterns differ from language models, so directly applying one-dimensional optimizations may be suboptimal. This benchmark provides a reproducible evaluation framework and empirical regularities across hardware and backends, helping researchers and engineers choose suitable attention implementations for tabular models and pointing toward table-native attention improvements.
cards.description: 该研究针对表格上下文学习模型特有的行列交替注意力模式，构建了可复现基准，系统比较了 Torch SDPA、FlashAttention-2/3/4、vLLM 与 SageAttention 在三种 GPU 上的前向与反向吞吐。新意在于首次将高效注意力评测从一维语言序列扩展到二维表格场景，并揭示最优后端随列/行注意力、序列长度、头维度和硬件而变，为表格原生注意力优化提供依据。
keyPointsEn: Tabular attention differs markedly from one-dimensional language attention in sequence lengths and memory layout, but efficient attention benchmarks for the two-dimensional tabular setting were previously lacking.
Forward and backward throughput are measured on A100/H100/B200 across Torch SDPA, FlashAttention-2/3/4, vLLM, and SageAttention.

The optimal backend depends on attention type (column/row), sequence length, head dimension, and hardware; FlashAttention is overall best, cuDNN sometimes wins for long-sequence column attention, and SageAttention performs well for row attention beyond 16k rows.
cards.title: 表格基础模型注意力机制在不同硬件与形状下的基准评测
cards.summary: 论文指出表格上下文学习模型依赖行列交替注意力，其行注意力序列长、列注意力序列短，且表格数据内存布局分散，当前模型隐藏维度较小，而现有高效注意力研究多集中在一维序列。作者在 A100、H100、B200 上对多种注意力后端进行吞吐基准测试，发现最优后端在列注意力和行注意力之间不同，并随硬件与模型细节变化；针对各代 GPU 优化的 FlashAttention 整体表现最佳，但在长序列列注意力下有时被 cuDNN 超越，交叉点取决于头维度。作者认为该可复现基准为表格原生注意力改进奠定基础（属作者观点）。
cards.whyItMatters: 表格基础模型在真实任务中日益重要，但其注意力模式与语言模型不同，直接沿用一维优化策略可能次优。该基准提供了可复现的评测框架和跨硬件、跨后端的经验规律，帮助研究者和工程师为表格模型选择合适注意力实现，并指明表格原生注意力优化的方向。
cards.descriptionEn: This study builds a reproducible benchmark for the alternating row and column attention patterns unique to tabular in-context learners, comparing Torch SDPA, FlashAttention-2/3/4, vLLM, and SageAttention on three GPUs for forward and backward throughput. It is novel in extending efficient attention evaluation from one-dimensional language sequences to two-dimensional tabular settings, showing that the optimal backend varies with column/row attention, sequence length, head dim
cards.originalTitle: Benchmarking Attention for Tabular Foundation Models
keyPoints: 表格注意力与语言模型一维注意力在序列长度和内存布局上差异显著，但此前缺乏二维表格场景的高效注意力基准。
在 A100/H100/B200 上测试 Torch SDPA、FlashAttention-2/3/4、vLLM 和 SageAttention 的前向与反向吞吐。
最优后端取决于注意力类型（列/行）、序列长度、头维度与硬件；FlashAttention 整体最好，cuDNN 在长序列列注意力中有时更优，SageAttention 在行注意力超过 16k 行时表现良好。
cards.limitationsEn: This is a benchmarking study and does not propose new attention algorithms; conclusions are based on specific model configurations, realistic tabular shapes, and three GPUs, and do not cover all tabular models or hardware; end-to-end training/inference accuracy or downstream task performance is not evaluated, so backend selection advice should be validated in specific scenarios.

cards.limitations: 实验仅覆盖5个宿主家族，不足以做总体性能声明；结论不涉及向新单元库或工业设计的迁移。Bootstrap与Jackknife折叠仍复用训练家族，家族行被视为描述性证据而非独立试验，且五个家族结果不能替代独立总体试验。
cards.titleEn: Protocol choice strongly affects cross-family performance in feature-based hardware-Trojan detection
cards.summaryEn: Using the Trust-Hub corpus and fixing the parser, 36 gate features, class weighting, model settings, threshold, and family aggregation, the study varies only the test split: pooled gates, one complete netlist held out, or every variant of one host family held out. Random forest F1/AP falls from 0.914/0.978 with pooled gates to 0.636/0.851 with one netlist held out and 0.460/0.577 with a host family held out; XGBoost falls from 0.946/0.976 to 0.464/0.544. The authors treat this as narrow evidence that sibling benchmark variants of one host circuit can inflate apparent transfer, and recommend family-aware holdouts plus all five family results alongside pooled scores; five families are too few for a population claim.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The results suggest that in hardware-Trojan benchmarks with multiple variants of one host circuit, detector performance may be overstated when training and test share host logic. Reporting family-aware holdouts and all family results helps avoid fragile transfer conclusions.
cards.description: 该研究以固定检测器配置只改变测试边界，量化了Trust-Hub同宿主多变体在训练与测试折叠间复用造成的性能膨胀。它提供了家族感知留出评估的实证依据，对硬件木马检测基准报告有方法学价值。
keyPointsEn: The test boundary strongly affects metrics: random forest F1/AP drops from 0.914/0.978 with pooled gates to 0.460/0.577 with a host family held out.
Direction is consistent across models: XGBoost falls from 0.946/0.976 to 0.464/0.544, while logistic regression loses AP but its fixed-threshold F1 is not monotonic.
Feature removal, repeated seeds, score normalization, and smaller samples change the gap size without reversing its direction, and aggregation choices also affect interpretation.
cards.title: 硬件木马检测评估：协议选择会显著影响跨家族性能
cards.summary: 研究在Trust-Hub语料上固定解析器、36维门特征、类别权重、模型设置、阈值和家族聚合方式，仅改变测试集划分：混合门、留出一个完整网表或留出一个宿主家族的全部变体。随机森林的F1/AP从混合门下的0.914/0.978降至留出网表的0.636/0.851，再到留出宿主家族的0.460/0.577；XGBoost从0.946/0.976降至0.464/0.544。作者认为这支持一个较窄的结论：同一宿主电路的兄弟基准变体可能高估表观迁移能力，建议同时报告家族感知留出结果与混合分数；五个家族不足以做总体推断。
cards.whyItMatters: 结果提示，在含多个同宿主变体的硬件木马基准中，若训练与测试共享宿主逻辑，检测器表现可能被高估；报告家族感知留出与全部家族结果有助于避免不稳健的迁移结论。
cards.descriptionEn: Holding detector configuration fixed and varying only the test boundary, this study quantifies how reuse of Trust-Hub host variants across train and test folds inflates apparent performance. It provides empirical grounding for family-aware holdout evaluation in hardware-Trojan benchmarks.
cards.originalTitle: Protocol effects on feature-based hardware-Trojan detection across Trust-Hub families
keyPoints: 测试边界选择对检测指标影响显著：随机森林F1/AP从0.914/0.978（混合门）降至0.460/0.577（留出宿主家族）。
跨模型一致性存在：XGBoost从0.946/0.976降至0.464/0.544，逻辑回归AP下降但固定阈值F1非单调。
特征移除、随机种子、归一化和样本量变化改变差距大小但未反转方向，家族聚合方式也会影响数值解读。
cards.limitationsEn: The experiment covers only five host families, which is too few for a population claim, and it says nothing about transfer to a new cell library or an industrial design. Bootstrap and jackknife folds still reuse training families, family rows are treated as descriptive evidence rather than independent trials, and the five family results cannot substitute for an independent population trial.

cards.limitations: 以上信息全部来自 GitHub Trending Daily 的项目自述，输入中未提供作者、独立评测、基准数据或论文；约 98% 的降幅与 17 个平台的覆盖范围均为项目方声明，未经第三方复核，也未说明具体测量条件。当前无法判断其在不同工具链、编程语言与任务类型下的实际效果，也不构成任何使用或投资建议。
cards.titleEn: Context Window Optimization for AI Coding Agents
cards.summaryEn: The project targets AI coding agents whose context windows are filled by tool output, using sandboxed tool output, persisted session memory, and routing via MCP and hooks. It claims about a 98% reduction in context usage and support for 17 platforms. Both figures come from the project's own description, with no independent benchmark or paper supplied, so they should be treated as unverified engineering claims.
cards.whyItMattersEn: AI coding agents have limited context windows, and tool output often exhausts the budget quickly; sandboxing output and persisting memory could lower per-call cost and extend usable task length, while cross-platform routing affects reuse across multiple environments.
cards.description: 该项目提出针对 AI 编程智能体的上下文窗口优化方案，通过沙箱化工具输出声称可减少约 98% 的上下文占用，并借助 MCP 与 hooks 在 17 个平台上持久化会话记忆、执行路由。
keyPointsEn: Provides context window optimization, claiming roughly 98% reduction in context usage by sandboxing tool output.
Persists session memory so agents retain state across sessions instead of re-passing context.
Enforces routing via MCP and hooks across 17 platforms for unified cross-platform access.
cards.title: 面向 AI 编程智能体的上下文窗口优化方案
cards.summary: 该项目旨在解决 AI 编程智能体上下文窗口被工具输出占满的问题，做法是把工具输出放入沙箱、持久化会话记忆并通过 MCP 与 hooks 做路由。项目方称可减少约 98% 的上下文占用，并覆盖 17 个平台。上述数字与覆盖范围均来自项目自述，尚无独立评测或论文佐证，读者应将其视为待验证的工程声明。
cards.whyItMatters: AI 编程智能体的上下文窗口有限，工具输出往往迅速耗尽预算，若能以沙箱隔离与记忆持久化来压缩输入，可能降低单次调用的成本并延长可用的任务长度；其跨平台路由设计也关系到多环境下的复用效率。
cards.descriptionEn: This project proposes context window optimization for AI coding agents, claiming that sandboxing tool output cuts context usage by roughly 98%, while persisting session memory and enforcing routing across 17 platforms via MCP and hooks.
keyPoints: 提供上下文窗口优化，声称对工具输出做沙箱化后减少约 98% 的上下文占用。
通过持久化会话记忆，使智能体在会话之间保留状态，而不依赖重复传入上下文。
借助 MCP 与 hooks 在 17 个平台上强制路由，实现跨平台统一接入。
cards.limitationsEn: All information comes from the project's self-description on GitHub Trending Daily; no authors, independent evaluations, benchmark data, or papers are provided. The claimed 98% reduction and 17-platform coverage are the project's own statements, not third-party verified, and the measurement conditions are unspecified. Actual performance across toolchains, languages, and task types cannot be judged, and this is not usage or investment advice.

cards.limitations: 仅凭 GitHub Trending Daily 的摘要无法确认工具的实际能力、准确率、适用平台和约束条件；缺少作者、论文、基准测试和可复现实验，不能据此推断其优于现有逆向工具；涉及逆向工程可能存在法律与授权风险，需自行评估合规性。
cards.titleEn: rea: Using Agents to Reverse Engineer App Behavior and Native Binaries
cards.summaryEn: The project appears on GitHub Trending Daily as morluto/rea, and the source summary states it can reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries. It has no listed authors or formal paper and currently looks like an open-source tooling exploration.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If agents can reliably assist reverse engineering, they may lower barriers in binary and app behavior analysis and increase automation in security analysis, compatibility research, and malware investigation; however, only a project self-description exists, so real performance needs code and independent validation.
cards.description: rea 是一个 GitHub 项目，主张用智能体对应用行为乃至原生二进制进行逆向工程，把传统人工逆向流程改由 AI 代理执行，为逆向工程提供新的自动化思路。
keyPointsEn: The project positions agents as the means to reverse engineer, covering app behavior through native binaries.
Information comes from GitHub Trending Daily, with the original link github.com/morluto/rea.
No author list is provided, and no independent experiments or evaluations are included.
cards.title: rea：用智能体逆向分析应用行为与原生二进制
cards.summary: 该项目来自 GitHub Trending Daily，标题为 morluto/rea，来源摘要称其可用智能体逆向任何对象，从应用行为到原生二进制。项目无明确作者署名和正式论文，目前属于开源工具层面的探索。
cards.whyItMatters: 若智能体确能辅助逆向分析，可能降低二进制与应用行为分析的门槛，提升安全分析、兼容性研究和恶意软件调查中的自动化程度；但当前仅有项目自述，实际效果需代码与独立验证。
cards.descriptionEn: rea is a GitHub project proposing to use agents for reverse engineering, from app behavior down to native binaries, shifting manual reverse-engineering workflows toward AI agents and offering a new automation angle.
keyPoints: 项目定位为用智能体完成逆向工程，覆盖应用行为到原生二进制。
信息来自 GitHub Trending Daily，原始链接为 github.com/morluto/rea。
未提供作者列表，也没有独立实验或评测结论。
cards.limitationsEn: The GitHub Trending Daily summary alone cannot confirm the tool's actual capabilities, accuracy, supported platforms, or constraints. There are no authors, papers, benchmarks, or reproducible experiments, so it cannot be inferred to outperform existing reverse-engineering tools. Reverse engineering may carry legal and authorization risks that require compliance assessment.

cards.limitations: 证据边界基于论文自身的数值示例与美国股票收益实证，未涵盖其他市场、资产类别或极端压力期；模型表现依赖高频数据质量与已实现尾部测度的构造；参数估计使用MCMC可能带来计算成本；文中所称优势需独立复现与多场景稳健性检验。
cards.titleEn: Realized Tail-Risk Conditional Autoregressive Expectile Models Improve Stability of VaR and ES Forecasting
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes a realized tail-risk conditional autoregressive expectile (RTCARE) model that introduces realized tail measures such as realized quantile and realized ES from intraday high-frequency returns into the dynamics and measurement equations of conditional expectiles to jointly forecast VaR and ES. Parameters are estimated via Markov chain Monte Carlo, and the resulting forecasts are evaluated in numerical examples and an empirical application using U.S. stock-return data. The authors report that RTCARE delivers competitive and often superior forecasting performance relative to existing alternatives across tail levels, with stable results in Monte Carlo replications and rolling forecast evaluations.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the forecasting advantages of RTCARE are reproducible across broader data and settings, it could provide a new modeling paradigm for financial institutions' tail risk measurement and backtesting by integrating high-frequency information, potentially improving the stability of joint VaR and ES forecasts.
cards.description: 该研究将日内高频收益构造的已实现分位与已实现ES纳入条件期望分位的动态和测度方程，提出RTCARE模型，用于联合预测VaR与ES。其新意在于把低频尾部风险预测与高频已实现尾部信息结合；对量化风险管理与回测具有潜在实用价值。
keyPointsEn: RTCARE incorporates realized quantile and realized ES constructed from intraday high-frequency returns into the dynamics and measurement equations of conditional expectiles.
Parameters are estimated using Markov chain Monte Carlo, targeting joint forecasting of VaR and ES.
In numerical examples and U.S. stock-return empirical analysis, the authors report that RTCARE has competitive and often superior forecasting performance across multiple tail levels.
cards.title: 已实现尾部风险条件自回归期望分位模型提升VaR与ES预测稳定度
cards.summary: 论文提出已实现尾部风险条件自回归期望分位（RTCARE）模型，将已实现分位和已实现ES等高频尾部测度引入条件期望分位的动态与测度方程，以联合预测VaR和ES。参数通过马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛估计，并在数值示例和美国股票收益数据实证中评估。作者报告RTCARE在多个尾部水平上具有竞争力且常优于现有替代方法，并在蒙特卡洛重复与滚动预测中表现稳定。
cards.whyItMatters: 若RTCARE的预测优势在更广泛数据和设定中可复现，可为金融机构的尾部风险度量与回测提供整合高频信息的新建模范式，有助于改善VaR和ES的联合预测稳定性。
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes the RTCARE model, which incorporates realized quantile and realized ES constructed from intraday high-frequency returns into the dynamics and measurement equations of conditional expectiles for joint VaR and ES forecasting. Its novelty lies in combining low-frequency tail-risk forecasting with high-frequency realized tail information; it has potential practical value for quantitative risk management and backtesting.
cards.originalTitle: Realized Tail-Risk Conditional Autoregressive Expectile Models: Accurate and Stable Forecasting Performance
keyPoints: RTCARE将日内高频收益构造的已实现分位与已实现ES纳入条件期望分位的动态和测度方程。
模型参数采用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛方法估计，目标为联合预测VaR与ES。
在数值示例与美国股票收益实证中，作者报告RTCARE在多个尾部水平上预测表现有竞争力且常更优。
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence boundary is based on the paper's own numerical examples and U.S. stock-return empirical analysis, without covering other markets, asset classes, or extreme stress periods; model performance depends on high-frequency data quality and the construction of realized tail measures; parameter estimation via MCMC may incur computational costs; the claimed advantages require independent replication and robustness checks across multiple scenarios.

cards.limitations: 研究基于单一南非金融机构的中小企业交易数据，样本与地区特定性可能限制结论向其他市场、客群或机构迁移。分类算法的准确率与 Gini 提升幅度为作者在其设定下的报告结果，尚未说明是否经过跨时间或跨样本外验证。摘要未提供具体数值、基准模型细节和消融实验，因此无法独立评估增益的稳健性与经济显著性。文本特征的解释性依赖分类体系设计，若类别定义变化，结果可能随之变动。
cards.titleEn: Enhancing Credit Risk Scorecards with Transactional Behavioural Features
cards.summaryEn: Using transaction data from small and medium enterprises at a South African financial institution, the study applies natural language processing and regular expressions to transform unstructured transaction descriptions into interpretable spending-category behavioural features. The authors report that the new categorisation algorithm achieves high classification accuracy, and that adding these features to a credit risk scorecard significantly increases the Gini compared with a scorecard without them. The authors conclude that text-based transactional information can be systematically extracted, categorised, and operationalised to improve credit risk model performance; this conclusion reflects the authors' view based on their experimental setting and still requires external validation before deployment.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the findings are reproducible, financial institutions could convert long-idle raw transaction descriptions into explainable behavioural variables without relying on black-box models, supplementing traditional credit history and repayment behaviour indicators. This may improve risk discrimination for SME borrowers and provide a reference for compliant use of alternative data in scorecard systems.
cards.description: 该研究针对信用风险建模中长期被忽视的交易叙事文本，提出一种可解释的方法将其转化为行为特征。新意在于用自然语言处理与正则表达式构建分类算法，把非结构化交易描述映射为可解释的消费类别，并验证其在传统记分卡框架中的增量预测价值。对量化风控实践而言，这提供了一条可审计、可落地的另类数据特征工程路径。
keyPointsEn: The study focuses on payment narrative text in SME transaction data as an alternative data source for credit risk modelling.

Methodologically, it combines natural language processing and regular expressions to develop and evaluate a structured transaction categorisation algorithm that produces explainable spending-category behavioural features.
The authors report high classification accuracy for the algorithm and a significant Gini increase when these features are added to a scorecard versus a version without them.
cards.title: 交易文本行为特征提升信用风险记分卡区分度
cards.summary: 研究以一家南非金融机构的中小企业交易数据为样本，使用自然语言处理和正则表达式将非结构化交易描述转化为可解释的消费类别行为特征。作者报告新分类算法具有较高分类准确率，且将这些特征纳入信用风险记分卡后，Gini 相比未纳入的记分卡显著提升。作者据此认为，基于文本的交易信息可被系统性提取、分类并用于提升信用风险模型表现；上述结论属于作者基于其实验设置的观点，实际部署效果仍需外部验证。
cards.whyItMatters: 如果结论可复现，金融机构可在不依赖黑箱模型的前提下，把长期闲置的原始交易描述转化为可解释的行为变量，用于补充传统信用历史和还款行为指标，从而可能改善对中小企业借款人的风险区分能力，并为另类数据在记分卡体系中的合规应用提供参考。
cards.descriptionEn: This study targets transaction narrative text, which credit risk modelling has long overlooked, and proposes an explainable method to convert it into behavioural features. Its novelty lies in using natural language processing and regular expressions to build a categorisation algorithm that maps unstructured transaction descriptions into interpretable spending categories, and in validating their incremental predictive value within a traditional scorecard framework. For quantit
cards.originalTitle: Enhancing credit risk scorecards with transactional-based behavioural features
keyPoints: 研究聚焦中小企业交易数据中的支付叙事文本，将其作为信用风险建模的替代数据来源。
方法上结合自然语言处理与正则表达式，开发并评估一种结构化的交易分类算法，生成可解释的消费类别行为特征。
作者报告分类算法准确率较高，且加入这些特征后记分卡 Gini 较无特征版本显著提升。
cards.limitationsEn: The study relies on SME transaction data from a single South African financial institution, so sample and regional specificity may limit generalisation to other markets, customer segments, or institutions. The reported categorisation accuracy and Gini improvement are results under the authors' setting; it is not stated whether they were validated across time or out-of-sample. The abstract provides no specific values, benchmark model details, or ablation experiments, so the robustness and economic significance of the gains cannot be independently assessed. Feature interpretability depends on the categorisation scheme design, and results may change if category definitions change.

cards.limitations: 结论限于离散时间不完全市场及有界有限维参数类策略；需要均匀指数可积假设；风险厌恶趋于零的极限分析不直接说明有限风险厌恶下的行为；数值展示仅基于特定 Heston 型正则化模型，未覆盖一般连续时间或更广泛市场模型。
cards.titleEn: Convergence of Restricted Entropic and Quadratic Hedging in the Small-Risk-Aversion Limit
cards.summaryEn: This paper studies the relation between quadratic hedging and entropic hedging when exact replication is impossible in incomplete markets. Fact: under restricted finite-dimensional strategy classes, the admissible gain set is compact and convex in L²; the author proves that, under a uniform exponential integrability assumption, restricted entropic hedging gains converge in L² to the unique restricted quadratic hedge as risk aversion tends to zero. Opinion: the result places both hedging problems in a common well-posed framework and illustrates the theory numerically in a Heston-type discrete-time stochastic volatility model.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The result bridges restricted entropic and restricted quadratic hedging in the small-risk-aversion limit, helping to clarify the asymptotic consistency of two widely used hedging criteria under finite-dimensional strategy constraints and providing theoretical support for numerical implementation.
cards.description: 新在于：在离散时间不完全市场中，将策略限制在有限维有界参数类上，使可允许增益集在 L² 中紧且凸。研究证明，当风险厌恶趋近于零时，受限熵套期增益在 L² 中收敛到唯一受限二次套期，为两类优化问题提供统一框架。
keyPointsEn: Strategies are restricted to bounded finite-dimensional parametric classes, making the admissible gain set compact and convex in L² and providing a common well-posed setting for restricted mean-square and exponential-utility hedging.

Main result: under a uniform exponential integrability assumption, a uniform small-risk-aversion expansion of the entropic risk functional over the restricted gain set yields convergence of the corresponding minimizers.

As the risk-aversion parameter tends to zero, restricted entropic hedging gains converge in L² to the unique restricted quadratic hedge, illustrated numerically in a regularized discrete-time Heston-type stochastic volatility model.
cards.title: 小风险厌恶极限下受限熵套期与二次套期收敛
cards.summary: 论文研究不完全市场中期权无法精确复制时，二次套期与熵套期之间的关系。事实：在受限有限维策略类下，可允许增益集在 L² 中紧且凸；作者在均匀指数可积假设下证明了小风险厌恶极限下熵套期增益收敛到唯一受限二次套期。观点：该结果将两种套期优化问题置于共同适定框架，并以 Heston 型离散随机波动率模型的数值实验展示理论。
cards.whyItMatters: 该结果在小风险厌恶极限下建立了受限熵套期与受限二次套期之间的收敛桥梁，有助于理解两类常用套期准则在有限维策略约束下的渐近一致性，并为数值实现提供理论依据。
cards.descriptionEn: New contribution: in discrete-time incomplete markets, restricting strategies to bounded finite-dimensional parametric classes makes the admissible gain set compact and convex in L². The paper proves that as risk aversion tends to zero, restricted entropic hedging gains converge in L² to the unique restricted quadratic hedge, providing a unified framework for both optimization problems.
cards.originalTitle: Restricted Entropic and Quadratic Hedging in the Small-Risk-Aversion Limit
keyPoints: 策略限制为有界有限维参数类，使可允许增益集在 L² 中紧且凸，为受限均值-方差与指数效用套期提供共同适定框架。
主要结果：在均匀指数可积假设下，受限熵风险泛函的小风险厌恶展开具有均匀性，并由此得到对应最小化子的收敛性。
当风险厌恶参数趋于零时，受限熵套期增益在 L² 中收敛到唯一受限二次套期，并在 Heston 型正则化离散随机波动率模型中数值验证。
cards.limitationsEn: The conclusions are limited to discrete-time incomplete markets and bounded finite-dimensional parametric strategy classes; a uniform exponential integrability assumption is required; the zero-risk-aversion limit analysis does not directly address behavior under finite risk aversion; the numerical illustration is based only on a specific regularized Heston-type model and does not cover general continuous-time or broader market models.

cards.limitations: 证据来自arXiv预印本，未经同行评审；数值实验限于论文所选的多维衍生品范围，未给出一般收敛性证明；对偶价格估计与超对冲策略近似为数值结果；方法性能依赖神经网络与策略参数化设置。
cards.titleEn: Stochastic Policy Gradient Methods in the Uncertain Volatility Model
cards.summaryEn: The paper addresses robust option pricing under joint volatility and correlation uncertainty in the multidimensional Uncertain Volatility Model, where the associated stochastic control problem is high-dimensional and numerically challenging. It proposes a backward actor-critic stochastic policy-gradient scheme whose key ingredient is a squashed Gaussian policy based on a C-vine representation of correlation matrices, ensuring positive definiteness by construction. Numerical experiments on multidimensional derivatives show accurate prices, computational efficiency, and favorable comparison with existing Monte Carlo and machine-learning benchmarks for robust pricing in the Uncertain Volatility Model.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a scalable numerical approach for robust option pricing under the multidimensional Uncertain Volatility Model and simultaneously provides approximations of both robust prices and superhedging strategies, which is useful for high-dimensional robust pricing research.
cards.description: 提出后向演员-评论家随机策略梯度格式，结合离散动态规划与近端策略优化，用单隐层神经网络近似值函数与控制策略，以C-vine相关矩阵的压缩高斯策略参数化连续控制并保证正定性。除稳健价格外，训练评论家的空间梯度近似超对冲策略，通过对偶公式评估其质量并得到对偶价格估计。

Continuous controls are parameterized through a squashed Gaussian policy built on a C-vine representation of correlation matrices, enforcing positive definiteness by construction.
The spatial gradient of the trained critic approximates the superhedging strategy, with quality assessed by a dual formulation that also yields a numerical dual price estimate.

cards.titleEn: Token Arcade: Understanding Structured Output and Constrained Decoding Through a Game
cards.summaryEn: Token Arcade is an interactive game built with Transformers.js that runs locally in the browser via WebGPU. It demonstrates that a language model's top prediction can violate syntactic or format constraints, such as generating a capital letter in a 'heads or tails' task, and then lets users experience constrained decoding by picking cards. The fact is that it uses local inference and gamifies next-token probability and allowedness; the opinion is that it makes structured output easier to understand.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It helps developers intuitively understand the mechanisms of structured output and constrained decoding, showing conflicts between model predictions and rules, and has educational value for applications that require reliable format output.
cards.description: Token Arcade 将结构化输出和约束解码展示为一个交互式游戏，展示模型的 top 预测如何违反规则，帮助理解下一个 token 的概率与允许性。
keyPointsEn: The model's top prediction can violate constraints, such as generating a capital letter in 'heads or tails'.
Token Arcade lets users experience constrained decoding by picking cards and trying to build a valid JSON creature.
It uses Transformers.js and WebGPU to run locally in the browser.
